pages.title: Fall Damage Loot
pages.text: In vanilla Minecraft, mobs killed solely by fall damage do not drop special loot that requires the "killed by player" condition.$(br2)This mod changes that: animals (pigs, cows, sheep, chickens, rabbits, etc.) killed by fall damage drop $(bold)exactly$() the same loot as if killed by a player — including rare items like rabbit feet.

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: $(bold)No experience:$() fall deaths do not drop experience orbs.$(br2)$(bold)A player must be nearby:$() full loot is only granted when a living player is within 32 blocks.$(br2)This behavior can be disabled in the config (fallDamageLoot).
A rabbit's rare drop, the rabbit foot, can also drop when it dies from fall damage.
